annotations.title: Convert a VBA macro (Office Scripts, Python, Graph)

description:
Converts a VBA macro to a modern platform: Office Scripts (TypeScript, Excel on the web), Python (openpyxl/pandas/python-docx), PowerShell 7 + Microsoft Graph (Outlook mailbox automation, since the new Outlook does not run VBA) or Windows PowerShell. target "auto" picks the best one from the static analysis. Returns JSON: the converted code, its language, review warnings (AI + automatic checks), blockers, security flags and risk score. The result is a draft to review and test.

Pricing: $0.10 per successful conversion (VBScript, VBA or EWS). 3 free conversions per day without an API key; pay per call autonomously through the Apify Actor ali-lamtoueq/vbscript-to-powershell (x402/MPP/Skyfire).

context.description: Optional: what the macro is for and how it is used (e.g. "runs when an email arrives", "monthly report from 3 workbooks"). Max 1000 characters.

target.description: Target platform. Default: auto (recommended target from scan_vba).
